responseMessageContents.text:
The Render error is now identified exactly:

```text
backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts: Unexpected end of file
```

**Root cause:** GitHub stored that file as a single Base64-encoded blob instead of TypeScript source. Render’s bundler tried to parse the encoded text as code and exited with status 1.

I repaired the local source as normal TypeScript, added the missing safe record helper used by the SES status path, and validated it successfully with the production-style Node bundle check.

**Not yet live:** GitHub `main` still serves the old Base64 blob, and production remains on `905ebdc…`. The corrected source needs to sync to GitHub; with **Auto-Deploy = On Commit**, Render should then automatically build it. I will only mark deployment complete when:
`GitHub SHA = /version SHA = /health SHA`.

We fixed the file and turned on automatic updates so that future changes will go live without extra steps.
